title: Buckwheat and Spelt Mushroom Stromboli with Fontina and Roasted Peppers
changes_from_base: A nutty buckwheat, spelt and bread-flour dough replaces the plain white dough, and a cooled filling of browned mushrooms, onion, spinach, thyme, tarragon, roasted peppers and fontina takes the place of the spinach, ricotta and mozzarella; the recipe makes two logs.
summary: Two savoury loaves of yeast dough studded with mushrooms, spinach, peppers and melted cheese, baked until golden.

ingredients.item: strong white bread flour, plus extra for dusting
fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt
jar roasted red peppers, drained and diced
large egg, beaten with 1 tbsp water

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Combine buckwheat flour, spelt flour, white bread flour, fast-action yeast, olive oil, salt and water (starting with 200 ml), kneading for 6–8 min until the dough becomes smooth and slightly tacky.

steps.title: Proof
steps.text: Cover and allow to rise to double its size, which takes roughly 1 hour.

steps.title: Cook filling
steps.text: Heat olive oil in the frying pan over medium-high, add sliced mushrooms and stir for about 5 min until their moisture evaporates, then season them, stir in the diced onion until translucent, add the spinach briefly until wilted, tip everything into a bowl and add fresh thyme, tarragon, diced roasted peppers, then once cool, stir through the grated fontina.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Turn the risen dough onto a floured surface, cut in half and pat each piece to about 30 × 20 cm, then spoon half the filling down the middle in a 5 cm strip about 25 cm long, leaving 2–3 cm clear at the short ends.

steps.title: Seal
steps.text: Fold the short ends over the filling, fold one long side over the top, then roll to bring the other side across so the seam sits underneath.

steps.title: Prepare for bake
steps.text: Place both logs on the lined baking tray, slash the tops with 2–3 cm cuts, cover loosely with oiled cling film and let rest 30 min while the oven heats to 190 °C.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Brush with beaten egg and water mixture, then bake for 30–35 min until the dough is firm and just starting to colour at the edges.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Cool for 10 min, slice and serve warm.

tips: Let the mushrooms cook on their own first so they release and then lose their moisture—this prevents a soggy filling.
Cool the vegetable mixture to room temperature before stirring in the cheese, otherwise the fontina will become oily.
Cut the logs a few times across the top before baking so steam can escape and the crust crisps up nicely.
storage: Keep wrapped in the fridge for up to 5 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
